verdict.rationale: Windows has developer APIs, so this story applies. The pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy, though. The UWP-to-Windows App SDK migration guidance, the Windows 10 ESU program and general app-compatibility claims are adjacent lifecycle or compatibility material, not a versioned-API deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
